def solution():
    # Define variables
    closing_prices = [150, 152, 151, 153, 154]
    volumes = [200, 220, 210, 230, 240]

    # Calculate OBV, starting from zero
    obv = 0
    for i in range(1, len(closing_prices)):
        if closing_prices[i] > closing_prices[i - 1]:
            obv += volumes[i]
        elif closing_prices[i] < closing_prices[i - 1]:
            obv -= volumes[i]

    # Return the OBV on the fifth day in thousands of shares
    return obv
